neighbours.label: the sentence-final period of a news-report statement, especially one attributed to officials ('…, police said in a statement.'), where the next sentence of the report is due; sentence ends in fiction, recipes, letters or textbooks stay quiet
fire: The bridge will remain closed until inspectors finish their work, the transport ministry said on Tuesday. Officials expect repairs to take at least two weeks.
At least 40 people were injured when the train derailed, a hospital official said. Rescue crews were still searching the wreckage late on Monday.
The airline said it had cancelled more than 200 flights because of the strike. Union leaders said talks would resume on Thursday.
The suspect was arrested near the border, police said in a statement. Prosecutors are expected to file charges this week.
The central bank left interest rates unchanged, the governor told reporters. Analysts had expected a small cut.
Flood waters forced about 3,000 residents from their homes, the regional government said. The army has sent boats to the area.
The drugmaker said the recall affects about 50,000 bottles sold since March. Regulators said no injuries had been reported.
A spokesman for the mayor declined to comment on the lawsuit. The city council is due to discuss the case next week.
